title: AeroDASH: Asynchronous Vision-Language-Action Control for Continuous UAV Flight
summary: Onboard inference latency creates a mismatch between the trajectories predicted by vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the ongoing motion of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). We present AeroDASH, an asynchronous VLA framework for continuous language-conditioned flight. A B-spline policy is initialized through supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations, providing continuous trajectory references in position and yaw. During execution, trajectory fusion removes the expired prediction prefix and connects the remaining segment to the active reference with derivative continuity while limiting trajectory deformation. To account for deviations induced by asynchronous execution, execution-aware group relative policy optimization (GRPO) further adapts the policy using trajectory-level rewards. On the UAV-Flow test set, AeroDASH achieves a success rate of 76.56%, exceeding OpenVLA-UAV and AeroDASH w/o GRPO by 38.1 and 20.1 percentage points, respectively. Execution experiments show that AeroDASH sustains motion during inference and reduces acceleration, jerk, and speed fluctuations relative to asynchronous tracking of waypoint sequences. We further demonstrate language-conditioned flight with onboard inference and asynchronous trajectory execution. The code will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: AeroDASH introduces an asynchronous VLA framework for UAV flight, using B-spline trajectory fusion and execution-aware GRPO to handle inference latency, achieving significantly higher success rates in language-conditioned flight tasks.
tldr_zh: AeroDASH提出了一种用于无人机飞行的异步视觉-语言-动作框架，通过B样条轨迹融合和执行感知的GRPO来处理推理延迟，在语言条件飞行任务中显著提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 机载推理延迟会导致视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略预测的轨迹与无人航空器（UAV）的持续运动之间产生不匹配。我们提出了AeroDASH，一种用于连续语言条件飞行的异步VLA框架。通过专家示范上的监督微调初始化B样条策略，在位置和偏航方向上提供连续的轨迹参考。在执行过程中，轨迹融合去除已过期的预测前缀，并将剩余段与活动参考以导数连续性连接，同时限制轨迹变形。为考虑异步执行引起的偏差，执行感知的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进一步利用轨迹级奖励对策略进行适配。在UAV-Flow测试集上，AeroDASH达到了76.56%的成功率，分别超过OpenVLA-UAV和AeroDASH w/o GRPO 38.1和20.1个百分点。执行实验表明，AeroDASH在推理期间维持运动，并相对于航点序列的异步跟踪减少了加速度、加加速度和速度波动。我们进一步展示了带机载推理和异步轨迹执行的语言条件飞行。代码将在录用后发布。

title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
summary: Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation. To transfer these capabilities from pretrained EFMs to policies without action pretraining, we introduce TILDE (Teacher-In-the-Loop Distillation from EFMs), which synergizes on-policy distillation at student-induced states with learning from teacher-executed recovery trajectories. We further propose AutoDAgger, an autonomous data aggregation pipeline in which a robotic reward model is utilized to monitor task progress and trigger teacher intervention, thereby collecting recovery experience without human monitoring or manual control. AutoDAgger accelerates recovery-trajectory collection by more than $2\times$ compared with the human-in-the-loop method. By unifying learning from demonstrations, on-policy teacher supervision, and teacher's corrective behavior, TILDE improves task performance by up to $4.1\times$ over behavior cloning across three real-world tasks and supports effective cross-architecture distillation.
tldr: TILDE introduces a teacher-in-the-loop distillation framework that combines on-policy distillation with autonomous recovery trajectory collection via a learned reward model, significantly improving policy performance over behavior cloning across real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TILDE提出了一种教师参与循环的蒸馏框架，结合了在策略蒸馏和基于奖励模型自主收集恢复轨迹，在真实世界操作任务上显著提升了策略性能。
summary_zh: 大规模动作预训练赋予具身基础模型（EFMs）强大的操作能力，尤其在泛化性和闭环鲁棒性方面表现突出，但复现此类预训练需要大量的机器人数据和计算资源。为了将这些能力从预训练的EFMs迁移至未经动作预训练的策略，我们提出了TILDE（具身基础模型的教师介入式蒸馏），该方法将在学生诱导状态下进行的在线策略蒸馏与利用教师执行的恢复轨迹进行学习相结合。我们进一步提出了AutoDAgger，一种自主数据聚合流程，其中利用机器人奖励模型监控任务进展并触发教师干预，从而无需人工监控或手动控制即可收集恢复经验。与人工介入方法相比，AutoDAgger将恢复轨迹的收集速度提升了2倍以上。通过统一学习示范、在线教师监督以及教师的纠正行为，TILDE在三个真实世界任务中将任务性能较行为克隆提升了最高4.1倍，并支持有效的跨架构蒸馏。

title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.
tldr: This paper introduces VLA-Rolling, an inference-time framework that reuses the unexecuted action tail from flow-matching VLA models as initialization for the next denoising step, adaptively allocating denoising budgets to reduce inference cost while improving success rates across multiple VLA models and benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VLA-Rolling，一种推理时框架，通过复用流匹配VLA模型中未执行的action tail作为下一步去噪的初始化，并自适应分配去噪预算，在多个VLA模型和基准上降低了推理成本并提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 流程匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过迭代去噪高斯噪声来生成动作块，但通常只执行一个短前缀，然后在更新观测后重新规划。在这种滚动时域范式下，未执行的部分——即动作尾部——被丢弃，下一块则从新的噪声中重新生成。我们发现，这个被丢弃的尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进展：使用动作尾部初始化可以在更少的去噪步数下达到或超越原生10步高斯基线。然而，最优去噪预算在不同样本之间差异显著，这表明尾部复用应适应更新后的环境。基于这一观察，我们提出了VLA-Rolling，一种轻量级推理框架，通过三个阶段复用动作尾部：动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计，以及通过重新加噪和去噪预算分配进行置信度引导的精细化处理，而底层VLA保持冻结。在LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上对$π_{0.5}$、SmolVLA、X-VLA和MolmoAct2的实验中，VLA-Rolling在所有16个模型-基准组合中降低了动作块推理成本，最高实现$1.48\times$加速，同时在14个组合中提升了成功率，最高提升$15.08$个百分点。这些结果表明，动作尾部不仅仅是丢弃的预测，而是可复用的中间状态，能够实现更高效、更准确的VLA推理。这些结果也证明，动作尾部能够以更少的去噪步数支持生成更好的动作。我们的项目可在https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/获取。

title: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.
tldr: DiPLO introduces a self-distilled diffusion planner combined with a whole-body tracking policy for humanoid loco-manipulation, improving task success via self-distillation and RL fine-tuning, with successful real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: DiPLO 提出了一种自蒸馏扩散规划器与全身跟踪策略相结合的人形机器人移动操作框架，通过自蒸馏和强化学习微调提高了任务成功率，并在 Unitree G1 机器人上实现了真实世界部署。
summary_zh: 类人形机器人操作与移动相结合的任务（loco-manipulation）极具挑战性，因为它需要协调运动、平衡与物体交互，这使得仅依靠有限示范或从零开始的强化学习（RL）变得困难。我们提出了DiPLO（面向操作与移动的自蒸馏扩散规划框架），该框架结合了自蒸馏扩散规划器与底层全身跟踪策略。我们的规划器通过对来自人体到人形机器人重定向的运动数据进行监督学习进行预训练，而跟踪器则通过强化学习训练以执行这些运动。DiPLO围绕两个互补的后训练阶段展开。首先，我们引入了自蒸馏扩散策略优化（SD:DPO），以消除规划器对强任务条件的依赖——我们将其识别为有效预训练的关键因素，因为若省略该步骤，下游微调无法恢复相当的性能。随后，我们使用扩散增强近端策略优化（DA:PPO）对该蒸馏模型进行微调，这是一种针对扩散模型的最大熵强化学习方法，旨在提高任务成功率并使生成的规划与冻结跟踪器的执行能力对齐。这两个阶段共同使得仅通过状态历史和目标条件即可实现运动生成，在抓取-携带-放置任务中达到99%的任务成功率，而预训练模型仅为45%。由此产生的规划器还能为未见过的物体目标生成运动，并进一步在踢球和推拉任务中进行了评估。最后，我们将该流程部署到真实硬件上，使用DA:PPO规划器-跟踪器在Unitree G1机器人上实现了无需任何真实世界微调的重复成功执行。

title: Learning When to Adapt: Reactivity-Conditioned Residual Adaptation under Human-Robot Distribution Shift
summary: Pedestrians differ in whether they respond to a robot, yet many RL policies assume all are non-reactive to prioritize safety. Policies trained without conditioning on local pedestrians' reactivity may therefore be unnecessarily conservative or rely on cooperation that does not occur. We propose RCRA, an online adaptation framework that modulates a learned residual around a frozen conservative navigation policy according to estimated pedestrian reactivity. A Transformer-based estimator infers latent pedestrian reactivity from motion histories and robot context, providing a more accurate signal for navigation adaptation and improving scenario-averaged simulation accuracy by $12.62$ percentage points over the Bayesian baseline, which assumes known pedestrian goals. These estimates are spatially aggregated into an adaptation scale that gates LoRA modules, enabling cooperative behavior near reactive pedestrians and conservative behavior near non-reactive pedestrians. Among baselines achieving SR above $90\%$ in every scenario, RCRA reduces scenario-averaged path length by $16.7\%$ relative to the conservative backbone and by $7.3\%$ relative to randomized-training baselines. It improves mean SR by $14.88$ percentage points over the reactive-trained policy.
tldr: RCRA is an online adaptation framework that modulates a frozen conservative navigation policy via LoRA residuals based on estimated pedestrian reactivity, improving navigation efficiency and safety under human-robot distribution shift.
tldr_zh: RCRA 是一种在线自适应框架，根据估计的行人反应性，通过 LoRA 残差调制冻结的保守导航策略，在人类-机器人分布偏移下提高导航效率和安全性。
summary_zh: 行人对于机器人的响应与否存在差异，然而许多强化学习策略假设所有行人都是非响应性的，以优先确保安全。因此，若策略的训练未以局部行人的响应性为条件，则可能过于保守，或依赖于实际中不会发生的协作行为。我们提出了RCRA，一种在线自适应框架，该框架根据估计的行人响应性，对冻结的保守导航策略周围的已学习残差进行调节。基于Transformer的估计器从运动历史和机器人上下文中推断潜在的行人响应性，为导航自适应提供更精确的信号，并在场景平均仿真精度上较贝叶斯基线提升12.62个百分点，其中贝叶斯基线假设行人目标已知。这些估计在空间上聚合为一个自适应尺度，用于门控LoRA模块，从而在响应性行人附近产生协作行为，在非响应性行人附近保持保守行为。在各类场景中成功率（SR）均高于90%的基线中，RCRA相比保守骨干网络将场景平均路径长度缩短16.7%，相比随机训练基线缩短7.3%。相较于响应性训练策略，其平均成功率提升14.88个百分点。

title: T(R,O) Grasp++: Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping in Cluttered Environments at Scale
summary: Dexterous grasping in cluttered scenes remains a central challenge in robotic manipulation, as it requires high-dimensional hand coordination under complex object-environment constraints. To address this problem, we introduce one of the largest simulation benchmarks to date, comprising around 0.5B grasp annotations across eight dexterous hands and approximately 50K objects. Furthermore, we propose T(R,O) Grasp++, a scalable diffusion-based framework for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp synthesis in cluttered environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average success rate of 88% across eight dexterous embodiments. Meanwhile, our pipeline achieves only 0.3s inference latency while improving inference sample efficiency by over 10 times.
tldr: This paper introduces a large-scale simulation benchmark with 0.5B grasp annotations across eight dexterous hands and a diffusion-based framework for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp synthesis in cluttered environments, achieving 88% success rate and low latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个包含8只灵巧手和约5000万个抓取标注的大规模仿真基准，以及一种可扩展的基于扩散的跨本体灵巧抓取合成框架，在杂乱环境中实现了88%的成功率和低延迟。
summary_zh: 灵巧抓取在杂乱场景中仍是机器人操作领域的一大核心挑战，因为其要求在复杂的物体-环境约束下实现高维手部协调。为解决这一问题，我们构建了迄今规模最大的仿真基准之一，涵盖约50万条抓取标注，覆盖八种灵巧手和约5万个物体。此外，我们提出了T(R,O) Grasp++，一个基于扩散模型的可扩展框架，用于在杂乱环境中实现跨形态的灵巧抓取合成。大量实验表明，我们的模型显著优于现有基线方法，在八种灵巧形态上的平均成功率达到88%。同时，我们的流程仅需0.3秒的推理延迟，并将推理采样效率提升了10倍以上。

title: Energy-Score Stabilized Attentive Mixture-Density Policy: A Lightweight Approach to Multimodal Robot Motion
summary: For practical motion generation, it is essential to handle multimodality (multiple actions can be correct for the same observation) while maintaining low inference cost and strong generalization from limited demonstrations. We introduce an attentive mixture-density policy trained with the Energy Score that represents future visuomotor trajectories as explicit probability distributions with a single forward pass. Concretely, we output Gaussian mixture parameters for joint commands (and optionally attention points) and optimize them with the Energy Score (computed as a sum of 1D CRPS under a diagonal covariance assumption) instead of the negative log-likelihood (NLL) to avoid MDN singularities and gradient-scale instabilities. Our architecture couples explicit spatial attention with mixture-density outputs, enabling robust multimodal behavior selection under visual noise and small-data regimes. On an 8-DOF manipulator, the method generates distinct avoidance trajectories and stabilizes learning in obstacle avoidance. Moreover, in a randomized moving-object grasping task, where spatiotemporal multimodality and fast timing decisions are required, the proposed model outperforms Diffusion Policy by 15-25% under several unseen conditions, demonstrating superior generalization and real-time feasibility.
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight attentive mixture-density policy trained with the Energy Score for multimodal robot motion generation, achieving robust performance and real-time feasibility in grasping tasks, outperforming Diffusion Policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于能量分数训练的轻量级注意力混合密度策略，用于多模态机器人运动生成，在抓取任务中展现出鲁棒性和实时性，优于扩散策略。
summary_zh: 在实际运动生成过程中，关键在于处理多模态问题（即同一观测可能对应多个正确动作），同时保持较低的推理成本以及在有限示范数据下的强泛化能力。我们提出了一种基于能量分数训练的注意力混合密度策略，该策略通过单次前向传播将未来的视觉-运动轨迹表示为显式的概率分布。具体而言，我们为关节指令（以及可选的注意力点）输出高斯混合模型参数，并使用能量分数（在对角协方差假设下，以一维CRPS之和的形式计算）对其进行优化，而非采用负对数似然（NLL），以避免混合密度网络（MDN）的奇异性问题及梯度尺度不稳定性。我们的架构将显式空间注意力与混合密度输出相结合，从而在视觉噪声和小样本数据条件下实现稳健的多模态行为选择。在8自由度机械臂上，该方法能够生成不同的避障轨迹，并在避障任务中稳定学习过程。此外，在随机移动物体抓取任务中，由于该任务要求处理时空多模态性和快速时序决策，所提出的模型在多种未见条件下比扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）性能提升15%–25%，展现出更强的泛化能力和实时可行性。

title: Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video
summary: Estimating a humanoid robot's internal state from video has a wide range of real-world applications but remains unexplored. During interactions with a robot, its onboard state information may be unavailable due to privacy, ownership, or communication constraints. Meanwhile, online and AI-generated robot videos provide rich sources of data but typically lack corresponding joint configurations, limiting their direct use in robot learning. To address these issues, we present HumanoidPose, a new framework that treats vision as proprioception to recover full-body joint configurations in world space from video alone. Specifically, we combine pretrained human-pose features with robot kinematics in a unified model that predicts each embodiment's joint configurations. We retarget human motions to sixteen different humanoid embodiments, enabling scalable learning entirely from synthetic data. To improve real-world generalization, we further leverage unlabeled online videos through self-training to develop a 2D robot-pose detector. In our evaluation, HumanoidPose improves joint-angle and joint-position accuracy over the evaluated baselines and reduces joint-angle error by 18-32% relative to the best-performing baseline on each of the three real humanoid platforms. We further show improved global localization and generalization to unseen embodiments. HumanoidPose enables visual understanding of other robots during interaction and extraction of robot motion from online and generated videos.
tldr: HumanoidPose estimates full-body humanoid robot joint configurations from video alone by combining pretrained human-pose features with robot kinematics, trained on synthetic data with self-training on unlabeled online videos, improving pose accuracy on three real humanoid platforms.
tldr_zh: HumanoidPose 通过结合预训练的人体姿态特征与机器人运动学，仅从视频中估计人形机器人的全身关节配置，利用合成数据训练并在无标注网络视频上自训练，在三个真实人形平台上提升了姿态精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：从视频中估计人形机器人的内部状态具有广泛的现实应用，但这一领域尚未得到充分探索。在与机器人交互过程中，由于隐私、所有权或通信限制，其机载状态信息可能无法获取。与此同时，在线视频和AI生成的机器人视频提供了丰富的数据来源，但通常缺乏相应的关节配置信息，限制了它们在机器人学习中的直接应用。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HumanoidPose，一种新框架，将视觉视为本体感觉，仅凭视频即可恢复世界坐标系下的全身关节配置。具体而言，我们将预训练的人体姿态特征与机器人运动学结合在一个统一模型中，以预测各具体形态的关节配置。我们将人体动作重定向到十六种不同的人形机器人形态，从而实现完全基于合成数据的可扩展学习。为提高现实世界的泛化能力，我们进一步利用未标注的在线视频，通过自训练开发了一个二维机器人姿态检测器。在评估中，HumanoidPose在关节角度和关节位置精度上均优于所评估的基线方法，并且在三个真实人形机器人平台上，相对于各平台表现最佳的基线方法，关节角度误差降低了18-32%。我们进一步展示了改进的全局定位能力以及对未见形态的泛化能力。HumanoidPose使得在交互过程中能够从视觉上理解其他机器人，并能从在线视频和生成视频中提取机器人运动信息。

title: The Bitter Lesson Comes to Robotics
summary: General purpose multimodal language models (LMs) are increasingly capable of directly controlling robotic arms (e.g., by commanding end effector poses) to manipulate their environment. Tracking the development of these capabilities is important for understanding their potential benefits, such as improving industrial automation, and risks, such as enabling malicious users to produce dangerous chemical or biological agents. To this end, we investigate the ability of frontier multimodal LMs to directly control physical robotic arms. We evaluate seven models at multiple reasoning-effort settings on six manipulation tasks taken from the RoboDojo benchmark. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic comparison of a broad range of frontier LMs across a common suite of manipulation tasks on physical hardware. We find that current frontier models can directly control real robotic arms to perform a variety of manipulation tasks but are not yet precise or efficient enough to complete them within a practical action budget. However, these capabilities are improving rapidly: performance increases on our benchmark between July and September 2026 (inclusive) correspond to a performance doubling time of 44.5 days, while the best recorded execution rate increased by a factor of 4.4 and the lowest recorded execution cost fell by a factor of 6.2. These trends raise the possibility that the Bitter Lesson is coming to robotics; the capabilities of embodied general purpose LMs may one day be comparable to those of more specialized models.
tldr: This paper evaluates seven frontier multimodal language models on six physical manipulation tasks from the RoboDojo benchmark, finding that while current models can directly control real robotic arms, they are not yet efficient enough for practical action budgets. However, capabilities are improving rapidly, with a performance doubling time of 44.5 days, suggesting the 'bitter lesson' may soon extend to robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了七个前沿多模态语言模型在RoboDojo基准测试中的六项实体操控任务上的表现，发现当前模型虽能直接控制真实机械臂，但效率和精度尚不足以在实际动作预算内完成任务。然而，能力提升迅速（性能翻倍时间约44.5天），暗示‘苦涩教训’可能即将适用于机器人领域。
summary_zh: 通用多模态语言模型（LM）在直接控制机械臂（例如，通过指令末端执行器姿态）以操控其环境方面的能力日益增强。追踪这些能力的发展，对于理解其潜在益处（如提升工业自动化水平）与风险（如助长恶意用户制造危险化学或生物制剂）具有重要意义。为此，我们研究了前沿多模态语言模型直接控制物理机械臂的能力。我们在取自RoboDojo基准测试的六项操控任务上，以多种推理努力设置评估了七个模型。据我们所知，这是首次在物理硬件上对广泛前沿语言模型在统一操控任务套件上进行系统性比较。我们发现，当前前沿模型能够直接控制真实机械臂执行多种操控任务，但其精确度和效率尚不足以在实际动作预算内完成任务。然而，这些能力正在迅速提升：从2026年7月至9月（含）期间，我们的基准测试性能提升对应的性能倍增时间为44.5天，而最佳记录执行速率提升了4.4倍，最低记录执行成本下降了6.2倍。这些趋势预示着“苦涩教训”可能正来临于机器人领域；具身通用语言模型的能力未来或可与更专门的模型相媲美。

title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
summary: Embodied AI lacks the data-rich pretraining that gave language models their agents and skills, so new manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode. We study a third route: a strong general model acts only as an offline author that writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs a manipulation skill in simulation until it passes an exam on layouts drawn after freezing; the frozen skill then runs as code alone or under a cheap caller that reads only its description. We call this skill-level recursive self-improvement Skill-RSI and specify a compile protocol (isolated, audited author; hidden validation layouts; no-feedback and inherit-only controls; tamper-evident ledger) and a reuse protocol that runs the identical files with executors from another model family. On 7 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with cluttered tables, Claude Code compiled 4 tasks into 7 frozen skills, 5 from a first draft needing only qualification, at USD 4.29-8.22 of author cost each (USD 55 per skill counting the 13 failed campaigns). The other three tasks did not compile in 18 campaigns, including five with GPT-6 and a pre-registered 150-layout run: on the hardest task every campaign scored 78-95 of 100 but had 3-16 safety aborts, failing the gate of 95% success with zero aborts; a 100-episode exam bounds an abort rate only to 3.6%. On hidden layouts, repair that inherits the previous version beat from-scratch rewriting in 8 of 8 controlled campaigns (sign test p = 0.004); an inherit-only lineage attributes most of the gap to inheritance, with development feedback adding a little (3 of 3, p = 0.125). Write-once campaigns found no detectable first-draft effect of practice (minimum detectable effect 14 points). The frozen skills kept 148/150 successes on new layouts with no model and 147/150 with a DeepSeek-flash caller at USD 0.00028-0.00054 per episode; no direct-control baseline was run.
tldr: This paper introduces Skill-RSI, a protocol where a strong general model compiles manipulation skills offline in simulation into frozen, portable code that runs cheaply without a frontier model. Results on RoboTwin 2.0 tasks show cost-effective skill compilation, with recursive self-improvement through inheritance outperforming from-scratch rewriting on hidden layouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Skill-RSI协议，通过强通用模型在仿真中离线编译操作技能，生成可冻结、可移植的代码，无需前沿模型即可廉价运行。在RoboTwin 2.0任务上验证了成本效益，并发现继承式递归自我改进优于从零重写。
summary_zh: 具身智能缺乏大规模数据预训练，而正是这种预训练赋予了语言模型其智能体能力和操作技能。因此，每新增一项操作能力，要么需要为每个任务收集演示数据，要么需要在每个回合中调用前沿模型。我们探索了第三条路径：一个强大的通用模型仅作为离线作者，在仿真环境中编写、运行、诊断并修复一项操作技能，直至其通过基于冻结后布局的考试；随后，该冻结技能仅以代码形式运行，或由一个仅读取其描述的廉价调用器驱动。我们将这一方法称为技能级递归自我改进（Skill-RSI），并制定了编译协议（隔离且可审计的作者、隐藏的验证布局、无反馈与仅继承的控制组、防篡改账本）以及复用协议，即使用来自另一模型族的执行器运行完全相同的文件。在RoboTwin 2.0的7个杂乱桌面任务中，Claude Code将4个任务编译为7个冻结技能，其中5个仅需一次初稿即可通过资格验证，每个技能的作者成本为4.29至8.22美元（若计入13次失败的尝试，则每技能成本为55美元）。其余3个任务在18次尝试中未能编译成功，其中包括使用GPT-6进行的5次尝试，以及一次预注册的150布局运行：在最困难的任务中，每次尝试的得分为78至95分（满分100分），但均出现3至16次安全中止，未能通过95%成功率且零中止的考核门槛；一次100回合的考试仅能将中止率约束在3.6%以内。在隐藏布局上，继承前一版本的修复在8次受控尝试中全部优于从头重写（符号检验p = 0.004）；仅继承的血统分析表明，大部分性能差距来自继承机制，而开发反馈仅带来少量提升（3次尝试中3次成功，p = 0.125）。一次性编写尝试未发现练习带来的可检测初稿效应（最小可检测效应为14分）。冻结技能在新布局上无模型调用时保持了148/150次成功，使用DeepSeek-flash调用器时保持147/150次成功，每回合成本为0.00028至0.00054美元；未运行直接控制基线。

title: Dream What I Can: Sparse Visual Planning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Video models provide rich priors for generalizable robotic manipulation, but plausible visual futures are not always executable. We introduce DreamCan, a hierarchical policy that grounds video models through sparse visual planning: a high-level planner adapted from a pre-trained video model and a low-level visuomotor policy. Rather than predicting dense trajectories, the high-level planner generates sparse visual subgoals that balance reachability and task utility. From offline, action-free robot videos, we estimate these quantities and use dynamic programming to select subgoal sequences without manual annotations. The resulting subgoals are more reliably attained than uniformly spaced alternatives, and the full system outperforms language, dense-video, and uniform-subgoal planners, reaching high planning success rates on Language-Table tasks and 91.2% success on LIBERO-Long with a 0.1B-parameter low-level policy. Additional suboptimal videos and test-time compute further improve success. The system also performs challenging real-world bimanual tasks, including box folding and packing with unseen object combinations. More results are available at https://dreamcan.github.io/.
tldr: DreamCan introduces a hierarchical robot manipulation policy that uses a pre-trained video model for sparse visual subgoal planning, improving long-horizon task success in simulation and real-world bimanual tasks.
tldr_zh: DreamCan 提出了一种层级机器人操作策略，利用预训练视频模型进行稀疏视觉子目标规划，在仿真和真实世界双臂任务中提高了长时程任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 视频模型为可泛化的机器人操作提供了丰富的先验知识，但看似合理的视觉未来并不总是可执行的。我们提出了DreamCan，一种通过稀疏视觉规划来锚定视频模型的层次化策略：其高层规划器由预训练的视频模型改编而来，低层则采用视觉运动策略。高层规划器并非预测密集轨迹，而是生成稀疏的视觉子目标，以平衡可达性与任务效用。我们从离线的、无动作的机器人视频中估计这些量，并利用动态规划在无需人工标注的情况下选择子目标序列。与均匀间隔的替代方案相比，所生成的子目标更易于实现，且整个系统优于基于语言、密集视频和均匀子目标的规划器，在Language-Table任务中取得了较高的规划成功率，并在LIBERO-Long上以0.1B参数的低层策略达到了91.2%的成功率。额外的次优视频和测试时计算进一步提升了成功率。该系统还能执行具有挑战性的真实世界双臂任务，包括折叠纸箱和包装未见组合的物体。更多结果请访问 https://dreamcan.github.io/。

title: SARAM: Sparse Adapter Allocation with Reuse and Merging for Lifelong Robot Learning
summary: Lifelong robot learning requires acquiring new tasks sequentially without forgetting earlier ones. With large pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) backbones, adapter-based methods effectively mitigate this challenge. However, their task-specific adapters and selection modules accumulate with the task stream, creating a scalability challenge in on-disk storage and deployment cost under fixed onboard resource budgets. We propose SARAM, a lifelong learning framework that limits storage growth while keeping GPU memory and per-step inference cost independent of the task stream length. For each new task, SARAM reuses frozen adapters from previous tasks and introduces new adapters only at sparsely selected layers, with a duplication penalty encouraging them to capture information not already represented by the adapter library. At deployment, a compact signature derived from backbone activation statistics identifies the task once per episode, and the corresponding task update is merged into the backbone, leaving only the backbone in the control loop. Across four LIBERO suites, SARAM matches or exceeds adapter-based baselines while adding up to 4.5x less on-disk state per task. GPU memory usage and control frequency remain comparable to those of the backbone as the task stream grows. Experiments on a real UR5 arm with a different backbone further demonstrate retention throughout a sequential task stream.
tldr: SARAM presents a lifelong learning framework for VLA backbones that limits storage growth by reusing and merging task-specific adapters, keeping GPU memory and inference cost constant as task streams lengthen, with real-robot validation on a UR5 arm.
tldr_zh: SARAM 提出一种针对 VLA 基座的终身学习框架，通过复用和合并任务适配器限制存储增长，使 GPU 内存和推理成本不随任务流变长而增加，并在 UR5 机械臂上进行了真实机器人验证。
summary_zh: 终身机器人学习要求在不遗忘先前任务的情况下顺序获取新任务。借助大规模预训练的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）骨干网络，基于适配器的方法能够有效缓解这一挑战。然而，其任务专用适配器和选择模块会随任务流不断累积，在机载资源预算固定的条件下，给磁盘存储和部署成本带来了可扩展性难题。我们提出SARAM，一种终身学习框架，它在限制存储增长的同时，保持GPU内存和每步推理成本不依赖于任务流长度。对于每个新任务，SARAM复用先前任务的冻结适配器，并仅在稀疏选定的层引入新适配器，同时通过重复惩罚机制鼓励新适配器捕获适配器库中尚未表示的信息。在部署时，由骨干网络激活统计量生成的紧凑签名在每个回合中识别一次任务，相应的任务更新被合并到骨干网络中，从而仅保留骨干网络在控制回路中。在四个LIBERO套件中，SARAM达到或超越基于适配器的基线方法，同时每个任务最多减少4.5倍的磁盘状态存储。随着任务流的增长，GPU内存使用和控制频率保持与骨干网络相当。在真实UR5机械臂上使用不同骨干网络的实验进一步证明，SARAM能够在连续任务流中保持任务记忆。

title: When Better Policies Leave Harder Failures: Coverage Shift in VLM Success Monitoring
summary: Can a better robot policy become harder to monitor? We study a fixed vision-language model (VLM) that judges success while a policy improves. In a controlled 20-seed tray-placement experiment, training selects only simulator-verified successes. Success rises from 66.8% to 97.0%, and accepted hover failures fall from 5.0% to 0.9% of executions. Yet the judge accepts 50.0% of remaining hovers, versus 31.1% under untrained sampling. These residual failures more often lie below the tray rim, which can conceal the gap beneath a grasped cube. A separate boundary probe accepts 148/160 below-rim hovers and 0/160 above-rim hovers. We call this change in conditional monitoring sensitivity coverage shift: learning changes which failures reach a fixed judge. A broader diagnosis covers nine judges and 1,392 stimuli. Judge-filtered experiments across eight settings further show heterogeneous effects of state-dependent acceptance. The results distinguish task improvement from failure detectability and motivate reporting absolute misses, conditional misses, and audit coverage together.
tldr: This paper investigates how improving a robot policy can reduce a VLM-based success monitor's coverage of residual failures, coining 'coverage shift' and showing that conditional acceptance rates worsen for the harder, remaining failure modes.
tldr_zh: 该论文探讨了机器人策略改进如何降低基于VLM的成功监测器对剩余失败的覆盖范围，提出“覆盖偏移”概念，并表明对更难的剩余失败模式的条件接受率会恶化。
summary_zh: 更好的机器人策略是否可能变得更难监控？我们研究了一个固定的视觉-语言模型（VLM）来判断任务成功，同时策略在持续改进。在受控的20孔托盘放置实验中，训练仅选择经模拟器验证的成功样本。成功率从66.8%提升至97.0%，被接受的悬停失败在执行中的占比从5.0%降至0.9%。然而，判断器对剩余悬停案例的接受率为50.0%，而在未训练采样条件下这一比例为31.1%。这些残余失败更常见于托盘边缘下方，这可能掩盖被抓取立方体下方的间隙。一项独立的边界探针接受了148/160个边缘下方悬停案例，而边缘上方悬停案例则为0/160。我们将这种条件监控敏感度的变化称为覆盖偏移：学习改变了哪些失败会到达固定判断器。一项更广泛的诊断覆盖了九个判断器和1,392个刺激样本。跨八种设置的判断器过滤实验进一步显示了状态依赖接受的异质性效应。研究结果区分了任务改进与失败可检测性，并促使同时报告绝对遗漏、条件遗漏及审计覆盖率。

title: Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping
summary: High-definition maps provide critical structural information for downstream autonomous driving tasks. Recent methods increasingly rely on external priors to improve prediction accuracy and robustness. Yet, existing prior representations expose a trade-off: dense rasters are easy to integrate but ignore certain map geometric properties, while sparse vectors preserve geometric structure but require dedicated encoders and are difficult to plug into existing architectures. Moreover, external priors can be inaccurate, costly to acquire, or difficult to maintain, motivating a structural representation that can provide geometric guidance while remaining learnable and broadly applicable. We address this limitation with the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation that encodes local lane structure at each spatial location and can be either predicted from onboard observations or constructed from external map priors. Building on this representation, we introduce a plug-and-play framework that enhances online HD mapping through two complementary mechanisms: BEV feature modulation, which injects lane-structured cues into latent BEV features, and deformable attention guidance, which steers query sampling toward the underlying lane geometry. We primarily evaluate our method on OpenLane-V2, showing that conditioning BEV features and guiding deformable attention with local lane geometry enables our framework to consistently improve existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception. Project page: https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/
tldr: This paper introduces the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation for local lane structure, and a plug-and-play framework that improves online HD mapping by modulating BEV features and guiding deformable attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种密集的BEV对齐几何表示——车道场，以及一个即插即用框架，通过调制BEV特征和引导可变形注意力来提升在线高清地图构建，在车道线段感知上达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 高清地图为下游自动驾驶任务提供了关键的结构信息。近年来，越来越多的方法依赖外部先验信息来提升预测精度和鲁棒性。然而，现有的先验表示存在一种权衡：密集栅格易于集成，但忽略了地图的某些几何属性；而稀疏向量保留了几何结构，却需要专门的编码器，且难以嵌入现有架构。此外，外部先验信息可能不准确、获取成本高或难以维护，这促使我们需要一种既能提供几何引导、又保持可学习性和广泛适用性的结构化表示。针对这一局限性，我们提出了车道场（Lane Field），一种密集的、与鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐的几何表示，它在每个空间位置编码局部车道结构，既可以从车载观测中预测得到，也可以从外部地图先验中构建。基于该表示，我们引入了一个即插即用的框架，通过两种互补机制增强在线高清地图构建：BEV特征调制，将车道结构线索注入潜在BEV特征中；以及可变形注意力引导，将查询采样引向底层车道几何结构。我们主要在OpenLane-V2上评估了该方法，结果表明，利用局部车道几何对BEV特征进行条件约束并引导可变形注意力，能使我们的框架持续改进现有方法，并在车道线段感知任务上达到最先进水平。项目主页：https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/

title: GeoV2V: Geometry-Grounded Video Diffusion Model for Driving Scene Generation
summary: Novel view synthesis under trajectory changes is essential for autonomous driving simulation, yet existing methods struggle to generate consistent videos when extrapolating to unseen viewpoints such as lane shifts. Reconstruction-based approaches maintain geometric consistency but degrade in visual quality under large viewpoint changes, while reconstruct-then-restore methods often produce visually plausible frames yet suffer from geometric and temporal inconsistencies. We present GeoV2V, a geometry-grounded video-to-video diffusion framework that synthesizes temporally coherent driving videos along novel trajectories by integrating LiDAR and depth-derived geometric priors with full-video conditioning in the Wan 2.1 backbone. A key challenge in learning cross-lane transformations is the lack of synchronized multi-trajectory supervision in real-world datasets. To address this, we also introduce Para4D, a synthetic dataset capturing synchronized multi-lane driving videos within dynamic scenes, which provides explicit supervision for lane-shift generation and serves as a strong training prior for geometry-consistent view synthesis. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Para4D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to complex lighting dynamics under large trajectory shifts. Project page: https://xiyuche.github.io/GeoV2V/
tldr: This paper introduces GeoV2V, a geometry-grounded video diffusion framework for synthesizing consistent driving videos along novel trajectories, using LiDAR and depth priors with full-video conditioning, and Para4D, a synthetic dataset for cross-lane supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GeoV2V，一种基于几何约束的视频扩散框架，用于沿新轨迹合成一致的驾驶视频，利用LiDAR和深度先验及全视频条件，并引入了用于跨车道监督的合成数据集Para4D。
summary_zh: 在轨迹变化下的新视角合成对于自动驾驶模拟至关重要，然而现有方法在外推至未见视角（如车道偏移）时，难以生成一致的视频。基于重建的方法虽能保持几何一致性，但在大视角变化下视觉质量下降；而先重建后修复的方法虽能生成视觉上合理的帧，却存在几何与时间上的不一致性。我们提出GeoV2V，一种基于几何约束的视频到视频扩散框架，通过在Wan 2.1主干中整合LiDAR与深度导出的几何先验及全视频条件，沿新轨迹合成时间连贯的驾驶视频。跨车道变换学习的一个关键挑战在于真实世界数据集中缺乏同步的多轨迹监督。为解决此问题，我们还引入了Para4D，一个捕捉动态场景中同步多车道驾驶视频的合成数据集，该数据集为车道偏移生成提供显式监督，并作为几何一致视角合成的强训练先验。在Waymo、nuScenes及Para4D上的实验表明，本方法在视觉质量、几何一致性及大幅轨迹偏移下复杂光照动态的鲁棒性方面均达到最先进水平。项目页面：https://xiyuche.github.io/GeoV2V/

title: Intent-Informed Model Predictive Control for Shared Autonomy in Remote Manipulation Tasks
summary: Shared autonomy is a control paradigm that combines human cognitive abilities with robot precision to enable effective remote manipulation in complex environments. A key challenge is how to adapt the level of autonomy using information extracted from the human, task, and/or environment. In this paper, we propose a novel arbitration strategy that dynamically adjusts the level of autonomy in the system using the entropy of a belief distribution derived from a multimodal intent inference. Human intent is modeled with a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN), which updates beliefs over goals given real-time operator gaze data and robot arm motion during teleoperation. We then formulate the blending of human input and autonomous control as a Model Predictive Control (MPC) problem, where the system's autonomous behavior is guided by the belief distribution. This approach enables continuous, gradual transitions across the full spectrum of autonomy levels, from direct teleoperation to full autonomy. To validate our approach, we conducted experiments to compare the performance of our proposed algorithm against two MPC-based shared autonomy methods. Compared to the baselines, our approach achieved reductions of at least 61% in object retrieval time, 44% in trajectory length, and 60% in human control input. Participants reported high perceived control, predictability, intent recognition, and responsiveness, along with low workload.
tldr: This paper introduces an MPC-based shared autonomy framework that dynamically adjusts autonomy levels via entropy of a belief distribution from multimodal intent inference, reducing task time, trajectory length, and human effort in remote manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于MPC的共享自主框架，通过多模态意图推断的信念分布熵动态调整自主级别，在远程操作中减少任务时间、轨迹长度和人为输入。
summary_zh: 共享自主性是一种将人类认知能力与机器人精度相结合的控制范式，能够在复杂环境中实现有效的远程操作。一个关键挑战是如何利用从人类、任务和/或环境中提取的信息来调整自主性的水平。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的仲裁策略，该策略利用从多模态意图推断中得到的信念分布的熵，动态调整系统中的自主性水平。人类意图通过动态贝叶斯网络进行建模，该网络根据远程操作期间的实时操作员注视数据和机器人手臂运动，更新关于目标的信念。随后，我们将人类输入与自主控制的混合问题表述为模型预测控制问题，其中系统的自主行为由信念分布引导。该方法能够实现从直接远程操作到完全自主的整个自主性谱系上连续、渐进的转换。为验证我们的方法，我们进行了实验，将我们提出的算法与两种基于模型预测控制的共享自主性方法进行比较。与基线方法相比，我们的方法在物体检索时间上至少减少了61%，轨迹长度减少了44%，人类控制输入减少了60%。参与者报告了较高的感知控制、可预测性、意图识别和响应性，同时工作负担较低。

title: GOFusion: Real-Time Gaussian-Occupancy Submap Fusion for Fisher-Informed Autonomous Robot Navigation
summary: In this letter, we present GOFusion, a real-time visual mapping system for autonomous robot navigation that anchors Gaussian primitives to local occupancy maps, providing both spatial awareness for path planning and high-fidelity appearance that enables information-driven robot navigation. GOFusion builds 3D Gaussian maps from pose estimates and local occupancy maps obtained via visual-inertial SLAM and enables pose corrections to maintain both geometric and visual consistency. Furthermore, it restricts the 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization to active submaps to bound GPU memory usage. Building on the appearance-rich Gaussian map, we introduce a rasterizer-integrated Fisher approximation that quantifies per-primitive sensitivity online, serving as an information-driven heuristic for Gaussian pruning and next-best-view planning. We evaluate GOFusion on public datasets and in real-world drone flights. It not only outperforms several baselines in mapping quality, but also achieves real-time, high-fidelity and uncertainty-aware mapping at scale. Finally, we demonstrate fully autonomous drone exploration for Gaussian map refinement using the proposed Fisher-informed heuristic. Code is available at https://github.com/Bennnoo/GOFusion. We provide a supplementary video demonstration at https://youtu.be/pLQKbxQvb6I.
tldr: GOFusion is a real-time visual mapping system that anchors 3D Gaussian primitives to local occupancy maps, enabling high-fidelity, uncertainty-aware mapping and information-driven autonomous drone navigation through Fisher-informed next-best-view planning and pruning.
tldr_zh: GOFusion是一种实时视觉建图系统，将3D高斯原语锚定到局部占据地图上，实现高保真、不确定感知的建图，并通过Fisher信息引导的下一最佳视角规划实现自主无人机导航。
summary_zh: 在本论文中，我们提出了GOFusion——一种面向自主机器人导航的实时视觉地图构建系统。该系统将高斯基元锚定至局部占据栅格地图，既为路径规划提供空间感知能力，又提供高保真外观信息，从而支持信息驱动的机器人导航。GOFusion基于视觉惯性SLAM获得的位姿估计与局部占据地图构建三维高斯地图，并支持位姿修正以同时保持几何与视觉一致性。此外，系统将三维高斯溅射优化限制在活动子地图范围内，以约束GPU内存使用。基于外观丰富的高斯地图，我们引入了一种与光栅化器集成的Fisher近似方法，可在线量化每个基元的敏感性，作为信息驱动的启发式策略，用于高斯剪枝与下一最佳视角规划。我们在公开数据集及真实无人机飞行实验中评估了GOFusion的性能。结果表明，该方法不仅在制图质量上优于多种基线方法，还能实现大规模、实时、高保真且具备不确定性感知的地图构建。最后，我们展示了利用所提出的Fisher信息启发式策略，实现完全自主的无人机探索以优化高斯地图。代码已开源，见https://github.com/Bennnoo/GOFusion，并附有补充视频演示，见https://youtu.be/pLQKbxQvb6I。

title: Structure over Reasoning: Unified Zero-Shot Navigation with a Small Vision-Language Model
summary: Vision-language navigation is moving into photorealistic, physically simulated scenes, where the leading zero-shot agents put a vision-language model in the control loop to choose every move and stop. Robots favour small models, whose abilities are uneven: Qwen3-VL-4B can judge whether a single view looks like the goal, but its route reasoning is at chance, its distance estimates nearly constant, its stop votes unreliable. Our agent therefore asks it two perceptual questions per step, which direction looks like the goal and whether the view justifies stopping, plus one gated frontier query on route-bearing instructions, and treats the answers as evidence, not actions: a route-blind semantic field over a bird's-eye map accumulates the directional scores through a tempered update, a skeleton graph supplies frontiers and geodesic distances, and a two-stage terminator turns stop votes into termini through a trail-consistency gate and a budget-forced return. With every baseline re-run in one installation at one budget, the agent exceeds all four zero-shot baselines of the VLNVerse subset in mean success on both granularities, though the paired interval against the strongest coarse-grained baseline includes zero. Termination is the dominant lever in ablation, thirteen attempts to give the model more of the navigation establish no reliable gain, and the agent runs on a Unitree Go2 quadruped with off-board inference. Code, per-episode logs and a robot video will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/structure-over-reasoning-PAGE.
tldr: The paper presents a zero-shot vision-language navigation agent that uses a small VLM for perceptual evidence, a semantic bird's-eye map with tempered updates, a skeleton graph for frontiers, and a two-stage terminator, outperforming baselines in VLNVerse and running on a Unitree Go2 quadruped.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种零样本视觉语言导航智能体，利用小型VLM进行感知证据、语义鸟瞰图和骨架图进行路径规划，以及两阶段终止器，在VLNVerse中超越基线，并在Unitree Go2四足机器人上运行。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航正迈向逼真、物理模拟的场景，在此领域中，领先的零样本智能体将视觉-语言模型置于控制回路中，以选择每一步动作并决定停止。机器人倾向于使用小型模型，但其能力参差不齐：Qwen3-VL-4B能够判断单一视图是否像目标，但其路线推理能力等同于随机水平，距离估计近乎恒定，停止投票的可靠性不足。因此，我们的智能体每步向其提出两个感知问题——哪个方向像目标以及当前视图是否足以判定停止——外加一个针对承载路线信息的指令的门控前沿查询，并将这些答案视为证据而非动作：在鸟瞰图上构建的路线无关语义场，通过温控更新累积方向得分；骨架图提供前沿点和测地距离；两阶段终止器通过轨迹一致性门控和预算强制返回，将停止投票转化为最终终点。在单一安装环境和单一预算下重跑所有基线，该智能体在VLNVerse子集的两个粒度上均以平均成功率超越了全部四个零样本基线，尽管与最强粗粒度基线的配对区间包含零值。终止机制在消融研究中是主导因素，十三次尝试赋予模型更多导航能力均未带来可靠增益，且该智能体已在搭载板外推理的Unitree Go2四足机器人上运行。代码、逐回合日志及机器人视频将在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/structure-over-reasoning-PAGE发布。

title: Latent World Models Should Plan with Distances Along the Latent Manifold
summary: Latent world models such as LeWM plan by searching for an action sequence whose predicted terminal latent is closest to the goal latent under an ambient norm, such as the Euclidean distance. Planning with such a cost assumes that proximity in the ambient latent space reflects proximity to the goal in the environment. Studying LeWM, we find that this assumption holds only in a small neighborhood around the goal, whereas farther away the L2 cost forms spurious low-cost basins that trap the planner. Yet neighborhood-based embeddings show that the latents retain the underlying physical state. We therefore hypothesize that the latents lie near a curved, low-dimensional manifold, and that the terminal cost should measure the distance along this latent manifold rather than through the ambient space. To estimate this manifold distance, we propose the Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC), which computes shortest-path distances on a mutual nearest-neighbor graph constructed over training latents. NGC changes only the terminal cost and requires no retraining. This single change improves the planning success rate of LeWM across all four benchmark tasks and nearly solves TwoRoom and Reacher: even at the farthest goal offsets tested, NGC reaches 95% and 100% success, whereas the L2 cost falls to 27% and 81%. These results support the manifold hypothesis and our argument that latent world models should plan with distances along the latent manifold.
tldr: The paper proposes a Neighborhood Graph Cost (NGC) that replaces Euclidean distance in the terminal cost of latent world models like LeWM, improving planning success by measuring distances along the latent manifold via shortest paths on a mutual nearest-neighbor graph.
tldr_zh: 本文提出邻域图代价（NGC），用潜在流形上的最短路径距离替代LeWM等潜在世界模型中的欧氏距离作为终端代价，从而提升规划成功率。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型（如LeWM）通过搜索一个动作序列来进行规划，该序列的预测终端潜在状态在环境范数（如欧氏距离）下与目标潜在状态最为接近。以这种代价进行规划的前提假设是，潜在空间中的邻近性反映了环境中与目标的邻近性。通过研究LeWM，我们发现这一假设仅在目标周围的小邻域内成立，而在更远的区域，L2代价会形成误导性的低代价盆地，使规划器陷入其中。然而，基于邻域的嵌入表明，潜在状态保留了底层物理状态。因此，我们假设潜在状态位于一个弯曲的低维流形附近，并且终端代价应沿该潜在流形测量距离，而非穿越环境空间。为了估计这一流形距离，我们提出了邻域图代价（Neighborhood Graph Cost，NGC），该代价在训练潜在状态上构建的互近邻图上计算最短路径距离。NGC仅改变终端代价，无需重新训练。这一单一改变便提升了LeWM在所有四个基准任务上的规划成功率，并几乎解决了TwoRoom和Reacher任务：即使在测试的最远目标偏移下，NGC的成功率也分别达到95%和100%，而L2代价则降至27%和81%。这些结果支持了流形假设，并验证了我们的论点，即潜在世界模型应沿潜在流形进行距离规划。

title: Scalable, Intuitive, Mixed Reality-Based Semi-Autonomous Robotic Telemanipulation for the Execution of a Fine-Grained Bimanual Task
summary: Nowadays, robotic telemanipulation enables humans to control robots so as to execute tasks in a manner similar to how they perform them, and serves as an essential approach for collecting on-robot data for robot learning by human demonstrations. The quality of collected demonstrations directly impacts the performance of the learned policy. However, existing telemanipulation systems rely heavily on human operation, particularly for large-scale data collection. Collecting dozens or hundreds of demonstrations is a demanding process, as operators tend to fatigue quickly, especially during the execution of dexterous tasks that require sustained concentration. Recently, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation has emerged as a promising direction that reduces operator workload while preserving human-in-the-loop control for task execution. We therefore introduce a scalable, intuitive, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation system that leverages a mixed reality (MR) headset for on-robot data collection. The system autonomously executes the majority of the task trajectories and only requires the operator to make fine adjustments at key stages. We validate the effectiveness of our system by collecting data and training imitation learning policies on the execution of a high-precision, fine-grained bimanual peg-in-hole task. With lower data collection effort, our system obtains high-quality demonstrations that can be used to train fully autonomous task execution policies.
tldr: This paper introduces a mixed reality-based semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation system that reduces operator workload by autonomously executing most of the task trajectory while allowing human fine adjustments, and demonstrates its effectiveness for collecting high-quality demonstrations for imitation learning on a bimanual peg-in-hole task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于混合现实的半自主机器人远程操控系统，该系统通过自主执行大部分任务轨迹并允许人工微调来减轻操作员负担，并在双臂插销任务中验证了其为模仿学习收集高质量示范数据的有效性。
summary_zh: 如今，机器人远程操控使人类能够控制机器人，以类似于自身执行任务的方式完成操作，并成为通过人类示范收集机器人数据、用于机器人学习的重要途径。所收集示范数据的质量直接影响学习策略的性能表现。然而，现有的远程操控系统高度依赖人工操作，尤其是在大规模数据采集场景中。采集数十甚至上百次示范是一项要求苛刻的过程，操作人员容易迅速疲劳，尤其在需要持续专注的灵巧任务执行过程中更为明显。近年来，半自主机器人远程操控作为一种有前景的方向应运而生，它能在降低操作人员负担的同时，保留人在回路中对任务执行的控制。为此，我们提出了一种可扩展、直观的半自主机器人远程操控系统，该系统利用混合现实（MR）头显设备进行机器人本体数据采集。系统可自主执行大部分任务轨迹，仅需操作人员在关键阶段进行细微调整。我们通过在高精度、细粒度的双臂销钉插入任务中采集数据并训练模仿学习策略，验证了系统的有效性。在较低的数据采集投入下，我们的系统能够获得高质量示范数据，这些数据可用于训练全自主的任务执行策略。

title: Anticipatory Gait Switching for Quadrupeds via Look-Ahead MDP Planning
summary: Quadruped robots often switch gaits to traverse mixed terrain safely. Many practical supervisors enforce hardware constraints (e.g., dwell or guard intervals) using a transition handler. However, the switch decision itself is often driven by near-field thresholds, which can delay commitment when rough terrain is only detected shortly before contact in the local height map. We propose a lightweight height-map-only gait supervisor that unifies look-ahead and locomotion constraints in a single decision policy. A robot-centered height map is partitioned into near-, mid-, and far-field bands, each discretized into a terrain class, and band evolution is modeled as a Markov process. Gait selection is cast as a look-ahead Markov Decision Process whose transition model and cost explicitly encode platform-specific switching constraints. Indoor and outdoor experiments on a Unitree Go2 platform show reduced late switching, lower time spent using ineffective gaits on rough terrain, and improved roll stability compared to tuned reactive baselines. Overall, the MDP formulation yields anticipative constraint-aware gait switching that improves robustness without course-specific retuning.
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight height-map-only gait supervisor for quadruped robots that models terrain band evolution as a Markov process and casts gait selection as a look-ahead MDP to enable anticipatory, constraint-aware gait switching, demonstrated on a Unitree Go2 platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅有高度图的四足机器人步态监督器，将地形带演化建模为马尔可夫过程，并将步态选择构建为前瞻MDP，以实现预见性且满足约束的步态切换，并在宇树Go2平台上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 四足机器人在穿越混合地形时，常常需要切换步态以确保安全。许多实际部署的监督系统通过过渡处理器来强制执行硬件约束（如停留时间或保护间隔）。然而，步态切换决策本身通常依赖于近场阈值，这导致在局部高度图中，粗糙地形仅在接触前不久才被检测到时，切换决策可能被延迟。我们提出了一种轻量级、仅依赖高度图的步态监督系统，将前瞻感知与运动学约束统一纳入单一决策策略中。该系统将机器人中心的高度图划分为近场、中场和远场三个区域，每个区域被离散化为地形类别，并将区域演化建模为马尔可夫过程。步态选择被构建为前瞻马尔可夫决策过程，其转移模型和代价函数明确编码了平台特定的切换约束。我们在Unitree Go2平台上进行了室内外实验，结果表明，与经过调校的反应式基线方法相比，该方法减少了延迟切换，降低了在粗糙地形上使用低效步态的时间，并改善了横滚稳定性。总体而言，该马尔可夫决策过程公式实现了具有前瞻性的、考虑约束的步态切换，在不依赖特定场地重新调参的情况下提升了鲁棒性。

title: Escape Without a Recipe: Maneuver-Agnostic Mars Rover Recovery from Granular Entrapment
summary: Wheeled planetary rovers immobilised in loose regolith have no principled recovery controller: scripted maneuvers are terrain-specific, and naive driving deepens entrapment. We introduce a recurrent policy that learns to escape without a predefined maneuver. The framework rests on a verified trap: in a continuum material point method (MPM) simulator we identify a configuration at sinkage-to-radius ratio z/r = 2.0 where the strongest of ten scripted controllers succeeds in only 7/32 trials, yet the regolith retains traction and continues to shear, confirming granular entrapment rather than a numerical artifact. A frozen entrapment detector, trained on 81,771 windows spanning three materials and six sinkage levels, supplies a three-state belief to the policy observation. A separate simulator mobility latch gates training rewards. Across five training seeds, mean action evaluation achieves 62.5% escape (range 28.1-81.3%; 32 trials per seed) versus 7/32 for the strongest scripted controller and 0/32 for action noise. A numerical audit identifies a coupling-buffer fault that silently discarded 9.7% of contact nodes at 16 parallel environments. Results establish recovery in the tested simulation regime; physical transfer remains unverified.
tldr: This paper proposes a recurrent policy that learns to recover a Mars rover from granular entrapment without predefined maneuvers, achieving 62.5% escape in an MPM simulator versus 7/32 for scripted controllers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种循环策略，无需预定义动作即可从颗粒困陷中恢复火星车，在MPM模拟器中达到62.5%的逃脱率，而脚本控制器仅为7/32。
summary_zh: 轮式行星漫游车在松软风化层中陷入困境时，缺乏基于原理的脱困控制器：预设动作脚本依赖特定地形，而盲目驾驶会加深陷困程度。我们提出了一种循环策略，无需预定义动作即可学习逃逸。该框架基于一个经验证的陷困场景：在连续介质物质点法（MPM）模拟器中，我们确定了一种沉陷-半径比 z/r = 2.0 的构型，在此构型下，十个预设控制器中最强者也仅在32次试验中成功7次，然而风化层仍保留牵引力并持续剪切，证实了颗粒陷困而非数值伪影。一个冻结的陷困检测器在涵盖三种材料和六个沉陷水平的81,771个窗口上训练，为策略观测提供三状态置信度。另一个独立的模拟器机动锁定门控训练奖励。在五个训练随机种子下，平均动作评估实现了62.5%的逃逸率（范围28.1%至81.3%；每个种子32次试验），而最强预设控制器为7/32，纯动作噪声为0/32。数值审计发现一个耦合缓冲区故障，在16个并行环境中静默丢弃了9.7%的接触节点。结果表明在所测试的模拟范围内实现了恢复；物理迁移尚未验证。

title: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
summary: Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.
tldr: This perspective paper argues that interpretability for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) must shift from decoding static representations to understanding the dynamic, causal structure of latent world models, proposing a four-stage 'Ground, Structure, Verify, Act' research agenda for actionable latent-world understanding.
tldr_zh: 这篇视角文章认为，对联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的可解释性必须从解码静态表示转向理解潜在世界模型的动态因果结构，并提出了一个四阶段的“定位、结构化、验证、行动”研究议程，以实现可操作的潜在世界理解。
summary_zh: 新兴的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）正从表征学习迈向潜在世界模型，以支持预测、规划与控制。然而，其潜在世界天然缺乏人类可解释的接口。在本视角文章中，我们认为，随着JEPA潜在状态成为预测与行动的内部状态，可解释性必须超越“它们编码了什么”，转向“潜在变量如何交互、演化并因果性地驱动预测”。为此，我们设想了一个四阶段研究议程，即“奠基（Ground）、结构（Structure）、验证（Verify）与行动（Act）”，以引导这一转向可操作的潜在世界理解的进程。在我们的框架内，现有的JEPA可解释性工作为“奠基”阶段提供了初步证据，而潜在结构的系统分析、因果验证与干预仍 largely 未被探索。总体而言，本视角旨在呼吁一个更广泛的潜在世界可解释性议程，将关注点从解码表征转向理解、验证并作用于潜在世界。

title: UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation
summary: World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.
tldr: UniState proposes a unified world-state representation for controllable world simulation, enabling joint control of object motion and camera trajectory while allowing the model to synthesize un-specified motion and interactions.
tldr_zh: UniState提出了一种统一的世界状态表示，用于可控世界模拟，支持物体运动和相机轨迹的联合控制，同时允许模型合成未指定的运动和交互。
summary_zh: 世界模型为探索提供了日益丰富的环境，然而在从自由选择的视角观察后果的同时介入世界仍然具有挑战性。我们通过引入UniState来应对这些挑战，这是一个基于统一世界状态表示的可控世界模拟框架。该表示统一了空间记忆与用户干预。用户直接在空间记忆中指定物体运动，同时独立选择用于观察最终世界状态的相机轨迹。这种统一使得场景与所请求变化之间的关系变得明确，从而从控制规格中消除了物体运动与视角变化之间的歧义。关键在于，指定一项干预并不需要预设每一个结果性运动：视频模型可以在受控物体内合成额外运动，并生成与其周围环境的合理交互。我们开发了训练和采样策略，使生成的视频能够遵循指定的物体运动和相机轨迹，同时保留超越规定变换生成响应的能力。实验证明，相较于现有方法，我们实现了更精确的联合物体与相机控制，并提供了定性证据表明干预引发的场景变化在连续展开中得以持续。

title: Visual-Inertial Odometry for Ground Robots with Dynamic Camera-IMU Extrinsic Calibration
summary: Visual-inertial odometry systems are often constrained by the assumption that sensors are rigidly mounted, which limits their adaptability in practical scenarios involving structural motion. To address this limitation, this paper investigates time-varying camera-IMU extrinsic calibration. First, a dynamic camera-IMU extrinsic calibration method based on the Denavit-Hartenberg convention is proposed by incorporating the robot kinematic model. Second, a two-step initialization strategy is developed to efficiently estimate the initial joint angles, providing a reliable starting point for subsequent extrinsic parameter optimization and enabling online estimation of timevarying camera-IMU extrinsic parameters. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively accommodate variations in camera-IMU extrinsic parameters while maintaining competitive localization accuracy.
tldr: This paper proposes a dynamic camera-IMU extrinsic calibration method for visual-inertial odometry in ground robots, using a Denavit-Hartenberg-based model and a two-step initialization to estimate time-varying extrinsic parameters online, improving localization accuracy under structural motion.
tldr_zh: 本文针对地面机器人的视觉惯性里程计，提出基于DH约定的动态相机-IMU外参标定方法，并通过两步初始化实现在线估计时变外参，在结构运动下保持定位精度。
summary_zh: 视觉惯性里程计系统通常受限于传感器刚性安装的假设，这限制了其在涉及结构运动实际场景中的适应性。为克服这一局限，本文研究了时变相机-IMU外参标定问题。首先，提出了一种基于Denavit-Hartenberg约定的动态相机-IMU外参标定方法，通过引入机器人运动学模型实现。其次，开发了一种两步初始化策略，以高效估计初始关节角度，为后续外参优化提供可靠的初始点，并实现时变相机-IMU外参的在线估计。仿真实验表明，所提出的框架能够有效适应相机-IMU外参的变化，同时保持具有竞争力的定位精度。

title: LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization
summary: Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.
tldr: LateMatch restructures deep visual feature matchers to make inter-image interaction cacheable, significantly reducing online computation for visual localization on edge devices.
tldr_zh: LateMatch 重构深度视觉特征匹配器，使图像间交互可缓存，大幅降低边缘设备上视觉定位的在线计算量。
summary_zh: 视觉定位对于具身智能体至关重要，但在边缘设备上部署最先进的深度特征匹配器从根本上受到其巨大计算成本的限制。标准深度匹配器在每一层都将图像内上下文构建与图像间匹配紧密交织在一起，造成了严重的交互瓶颈。针对单个查询在K幅数据库图像中进行定位时，系统被迫完整执行K次独立的网络前向传播，且不具备任何缓存能力。为打破这一瓶颈，我们倡导向可缓存图像匹配的范式转变。我们通过LateMatch实现了这一范式，这是一种通用方法，通过将图像间交互延迟至网络最后层来重构现有匹配器。通过将图像内处理隔离为可离线缓存的上下文块(Context Blocks)，仅需在线执行少量交互块(Interaction Blocks)。为进一步优化LateMatch，我们引入了E-SToRE(基于熵引导的空间令牌精简与扩展)。E-SToRE利用后期交互块中不断下降的香农熵，在跨图像交互之前动态减少令牌数量。在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D和Aachen数据集上的评估表明，与标准深度匹配器相比，LateMatch将有效计算成本降低了2倍以上，而E-SToRE在精度损失可忽略不计的情况下额外节省了10%至14%的计算量。

title: Operator-Mismatch Contrastive Learning for World-Relative Trajectory Coherence
summary: World models are increasingly judged by how well they rank plausible futures, yet plausibility alone is the wrong target. The same scene can evolve under many latent rules, and a future that is smooth and physically valid under one rule can be incoherent under the rule actually in force. We formalize the resulting failure, operator-blindness, and show that it is systematically hidden by standard evaluation: a scorer can attain near-perfect generic ranking while separating current-world from other-world futures no better than chance. We introduce Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC) learning, whose semantic hard negatives are valid-but-wrong-operator trajectories, and a matching protocol that measures world-relative coherence directly. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with in- and out-of-distribution operator parameters, across two trajectory-scoring backbones, and on feature-level external validation with CoPhy ballsCF, OMC raises operator-sensitive scoring far above a chance baseline that nonetheless achieves 0.99 generic top-1. We prove that the wrong-operator negative is necessary both for the protocol to detect the failure and for the objective to fix it, and position OMC as an auxiliary coherence signal (a trajectory-coherence scorer, not a generative model, planner, or control agent) that can be attached to existing world-model representations.
tldr: The paper identifies operator-blindness in world-model scoring—where generic plausibility ranking fails to distinguish trajectories valid under different latent rules—and proposes Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC) learning plus a matching protocol to measure and improve world-relative trajectory coherence.
tldr_zh: 本文指出现有世界模型评分中存在的“算子盲区”问题——仅基于通用合理性的排序无法区分不同潜在规则下的有效轨迹——并提出了算子不匹配对比学习（OMC）及相应协议，以直接衡量和提升世界相关轨迹的一致性。
summary_zh: 世界模型日益以其对合理未来的排序能力作为评判标准，然而仅凭合理性本身并非正确的目标。同一场景可以在多种潜在规则下演化，而某种规则下平滑且物理上有效的未来，在实际生效的规则下可能完全不连贯。我们形式化了由此产生的失败模式——算子盲视，并表明标准评估会系统性地掩盖这一问题：评分器可以在将当前世界与其它世界未来区分的能力不优于随机水平的情况下，仍达到近乎完美的通用排序。我们引入了算子失配对比学习，其语义硬负样本是有效但算子错误轨迹，同时提出了一种匹配协议，直接度量相对于世界的连贯性。在受控的合成基准测试中，涵盖分布内与分布外的算子参数，在两种轨迹评分骨干网络上，以及使用CoPhy ballsCF进行特征级外部验证，OMC将算子敏感评分提升至远高于随机基线的水平，而该基线仍能达到0.99的通用top-1准确率。我们证明了错误算子负样本对于协议检测失败和优化目标修复失败均属必要，并将OMC定位为一种辅助连贯性信号（一种轨迹连贯性评分器，而非生成模型、规划器或控制智能体），可附加到现有世界模型表示之上。

title: Localization and Neural Splatting on the Edge: An FPGA Scene Memory for Robots
summary: Resource-constrained robots and autonomous vehicles need scene memories that localize a camera and render nearby views without a desktop GPU. Scene-coordinate regression (SCR) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) fit because they avoid an SfM stage, but ACEsplat-style pipelines are GPU-centered, and moving them to an edge FPGA is hard because SCR is pose-sensitive and 3DGS rendering is irregular and capacity-sensitive. We present LENS, an edge scene-memory acceleration system on the AMD KR260 that brings an ACEsplat-style workload to a low-power FPGA/ARM platform. Rather than proposing a new scene model, LENS co-designs the two dominant kernels with the board data path: an INT16 SCR accelerator that preserves pose accuracy, and a bit-exact fixed-point ordered 3DGS renderer that rewrites alpha transmittance as a log-sum-exp recurrence and removes provably useless streamed Gaussians. All LENS latency, power, and quality results are board-measured. The SCR engine preserves DSAC* localization accuracy at 25.42 ms, the on-board renderer reaches 34.11 dB on Cambridge against ACEsplat's 33.20, novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K reaches 27.84 dB against 26.11, and all ten Wayspots scenes reach the ACEsplat rendering target. LENS wins performance per watt over a Jetson Orin NX on every deployment task, by 1.9x to 5.7x at about a quarter of the power, and is faster in absolute latency on localization and Wayspots rendering. On-device training reaches ACEsplat-level quality but not the GPU's time or energy, marking the remaining boundary for a future training accelerator.
tldr: LENS is an FPGA-based edge acceleration system for ACEsplat-style scene memory that combines an INT16 scene-coordinate regression engine with a fixed-point 3D Gaussian splatting renderer, achieving competitive accuracy and superior performance-per-watt compared to a Jetson Orin NX for robot localization and novel-view synthesis.
tldr_zh: LENS 是一个基于 FPGA 的边缘场景记忆加速系统，通过 INT16 场景坐标回归引擎和定点 3D 高斯泼溅渲染器，在低功耗平台上实现了与 GPU 相当的精度，并在性能功耗比上优于 Jetson Orin NX。

title: SurGPT: A Multi-Task Foundation Model for Robotic Surgical Skills Assessment and Gesture Recognition
summary: The assessment of surgical skills in robotic surgery training has traditionally relied on subjective evaluations by human experts, creating bottlenecks in surgical education and limiting scalability. We present a novel foundation model that automatically analyzes robotic surgical videos to provide comprehensive skill assessment and gesture understanding. Combining a visual encoder with a transformer architecture, the model performs three key tasks simultaneously: 1) surgical task classification (knot tying, needle passing, suturing), 2) skill level assessment on a standardized scale, and 3) natural language generation of surgical gesture descriptions. The model processes video sequences from the da Vinci surgical robot and generates human-readable text descriptions of surgical actions, similar to how language models generate text from prompts, using a multi-task learning framework with adaptive uncertainty weighting to optimize performance across all objectives. Our transformer-based architecture incorporates positional encoding for temporal understanding and attention mechanisms for spatiotemporal feature integration. Evaluated on the da Vinci Skills Simulator dataset, the proposed framework demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in surgical task recognition and provides interpretable skill assessments that correlate with expert evaluations, with the model's ability to generate natural language descriptions of surgical gestures opening new possibilities for automated surgical education, real-time feedback systems, and objective skill assessment in surgical training and certification programs.
tldr: SurGPT is a foundation model that combines a visual encoder with a transformer to simultaneously perform surgical task classification, skill assessment, and natural language generation of gesture descriptions from robotic surgery videos, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the da Vinci Skills Simulator dataset.
tldr_zh: SurGPT 是一个基础模型，结合视觉编码器和 Transformer，从机器人手术视频中同时进行手术任务分类、技能评估和自然语言手势描述生成，在达芬奇技能模拟器数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Learning Waypoints and Passage Events for Decentralized Multi-Quadrotor Trajectory Planning
summary: Multi-quadrotor passage planning requires coordinated spatial routes and passage times under vehicle dynamics and actuation constraints. Optimizing these decisions jointly couples temporal allocation, nonlinear motion, and inter-vehicle interactions, creating a computational challenge for local trajectory generation. We propose a learning-optimization framework that predicts spatial waypoints and ordered passage events for independently solved quadrotor planners. A common physical time grid aligns the vehicles, with intermediate events fixed by the networks and terminal progress optimized locally to permit different completion metrics. Differentiable sequential convex programming incorporates rigid-body dynamics and rotor-thrust bounds, allowing collision and completion gradients to train both networks through the generated trajectories. In a two-quadrotor evaluation across 24 layouts, the adapted policy passes physical feasibility and sampled separation checks in all five held-out layouts. Their mean completion metric decreases by 1.52% relative to the inherited policy. The median forward time is 21.01 ms on the held-out exchange layout with matching numerical trajectory references. These results demonstrate that learned spatial and event parameters can coordinate independent rigid-body planners while preserving local vehicle constraints in the evaluated scenarios.
tldr: The paper proposes a learning-optimization framework for decentralized multi-quadrotor trajectory planning that predicts spatial waypoints and ordered passage events, coordinating independent rigid-body planners while preserving feasibility.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于分散式多四旋翼轨迹规划的学习-优化框架，通过预测空间航路点和有序通行事件，协调独立的刚体规划器，同时保证可行性。

title: Finite-Time Capture by a Dubins Pursuer Against Unknown Evader Strategies
summary: We consider a planar pursuit-evasion problem in which a Dubins pursuer seeks to capture a slower first-order point-mass evader that can change its heading instantaneously. First, we propose a turn-rate feedback law with a single tunable gain and derive an explicit admissible gain interval that guarantees finite-time capture against any admissible evader strategy while satisfying the turn-rate constraint. Next, we obtain an explicit capture-time bound and characterize the turning authority required for the gain interval to be non-empty. Finally, we show that the dependence on the evader's speed bound can be removed by deriving a speed ceiling, computable solely from the pursuer's parameters, below which the guarantees hold at the maximum allowable gain. Numerical simulations illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper proposes a turn-rate feedback law for a Dubins pursuer that guarantees finite-time capture of a slower evader with unknown strategies, providing explicit gain intervals, capture-time bounds, and a speed ceiling.
tldr_zh: 本文针对Dubins追击者，提出了一种转向率反馈律，保证在追击者参数下，对未知策略的慢速逃避者实现有限时间捕获，并给出了增益区间、捕获时间上界和速度上限。

title: The Explainability Illusion: Must ViTs Exhibit Patch-Decoding Interpretability?
summary: Transformers are widely assumed to exhibit token-decoding explainability. In particular, in vision transformer (ViT) classifiers, decoding individual patch tokens has become a common diagnostic tool due to its tendency to yield human-interpretable outputs. In light of the increasing popularity of this approach, an important question is whether token-decoding explainability is an inherent property of transformers that should be expected to hold across architectures, scales, and training objectives, or merely an artifact of some implicit bias. In this paper we systematically study token-decoding explainability across diverse ViT settings, spanning architectures, scales, and training objectives, using both controlled experiments and real-world models. We find that while some models indeed exhibit aligned and interpretable token decodings, others exhibit either inverted explainability maps or a complete lack of correlation with the image semantics. As we show, these tendencies toward different explainability behaviors are not intrinsic to the architecture and can vary arbitrarily with changes in the optimization landscape. We provide theoretical support for these observations by demonstrating a setting where a single fixed toy transformer architecture can provably implement the optimal classification rule in multiple ways, which differ in their patch-decoding explainability patterns. Our results show that token-decoding explainability is not an inherent property of trained transformers, but rather an outcome contingent on the problem setting and thus should not be a-priori assumed to hold. Code can be found in https://ronensc.github.io/Explainability-Illusion/ .
tldr: This paper investigates whether token-decoding explainability is an inherent property of vision transformers, finding that it is not and can vary arbitrarily with optimization settings.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了视觉Transformer的token解码可解释性是否是其固有属性，发现并非如此，且会随优化设置任意变化。

title: AI-Enhanced Radiation Classification in ROS
summary: This study presents the development of two Robot Operating System (ROS) nodes with a primary focus on differentiating seven radioactive isotopes. The first node, referred to as the model training node, uses a Gradient Boosting classifier to identify and classify these isotopes. The classifier achieved a reported overall accuracy of 95\% on the held-out test dataset. The second node, known as the prediction node, provides classification results when users input data in CSV format. For the practical demonstration, the C12137 radiation detector module was mounted on the Jackal UGV, and an operator approached different radiation sources to collect data. To support future dataset expansion, we also developed a method for converting gamma-spectrum graph images into CSV files. In a separate robotic evaluation across three source locations, 30 of 42 trials were correctly classified (71.43\%). Am-241, Co-60, Cs-137, Na-22, and Ti-44 were correctly classified in all six trials each, whereas Ba-133 and Eu-152 were incorrectly classified in all six trials each. These results show lower accuracy in robotic trials than in the held-out test set.
tldr: This paper develops ROS nodes using Gradient Boosting to classify radioactive isotopes with a detector on a Jackal UGV, achieving 95% on held-out data but only 71.43% in robotic trials.
tldr_zh: 本文开发了使用梯度提升分类器在Jackal UGV上对放射性同位素进行分类的ROS节点，在保留数据上准确率达95%，但在机器人试验中仅为71.43%。

title: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets
summary: A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. The models are a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, the same network without that state, LightGBM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral, seasonal naive, and an equal-weight average of the world model, LightGBM and TimesFM given the plan. The answer changed with the grain. For an item by store and an item across stores, the average had the lowest error on seven and eight of nine data sets, and the 90% confidence set held a median of 1 and 2 models. For a category by store, a category and the chain total, the lowest-error model differed between data sets and a median of 4 of nine models were not separated by the four to six windows available. For category-by-store planning cost, the average or LightGBM was lowest on seven of eight data sets, and the world model was lowest only on M5; it was behind LightGBM item by store on six of eight. Every trained model used the plan, and on the weekly promotion-driven data pretrained models were less accurate without it. These results hold for these data sets; a forecast solved across all four Ps, or a retailer's own data, may give different results. Every model, test and change that lost is reported.
tldr: This paper benchmarks forecasting models, including a world model, LightGBM, and foundation models, across retail data sets at different product/store/time grains, finding that model ranking depends on the grain and that an equal-weight average performs best for item-level forecasts.
tldr_zh: 本文在多个零售数据集上，针对不同产品/门店/时间粒度，比较了包括世界模型、LightGBM 和基础模型在内的预测模型，发现模型排名随粒度变化，且等权平均在单品级预测中表现最佳。

title: CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI
summary: Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.
tldr: CoRe-WM applies world-model-based representation learning to longitudinal breast cancer imaging, predicting pathologic complete response by learning a latent state-transition model conditioned on patient and treatment, achieving state-of-the-art discrimination on I-SPY2 and robust cross-cohort transfer.
tldr_zh: CoRe-WM将基于世界模型的表示学习应用于纵向乳腺癌影像，通过学习患者与治疗条件化的潜在状态转移模型来预测病理完全缓解，在I-SPY2上达到最优判别性能并展现稳健的跨队列迁移能力。

title: A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation
summary: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
summary: Prompt engineering has become a central mechanism for guiding the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a wide range of reasoning and language understanding tasks [1], [2]. However, existing studies frequently evaluate prompting techniques using different LLMs, datasets, or task settings, making direct comparisons across methods and domains difficult [3]. Consequently, in this paper we present a controlled cross-domain evaluation of Zero-Shot prompting, Few-Shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automatic prompt optimization based on a PE2-inspired optimization pipeline [4]-[6]. All experiments were conducted with the same LLM and evaluated on six benchmark datasets covering arithmetic reasoning, logical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and factual verification.
